arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 200 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND concept_class_id='Ingredient' AND (LOWER(concept_name) IN ('cisplatin','carboplatin','paclitaxel','docetaxel','pemetrexed','gemcitabine','etoposide','vinorelbine','vinblastine','vincristine','doxorubicin','cyclophosphamide','irinotecan','topotecan') OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%platinum%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%taxane%') ORDER BY concept_name

WITH lung_ca AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS lung_dx_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
        SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443388,258369,4115276,37166577,42542211,42542234)
        UNION SELECT 443388 UNION SELECT 258369 UNION SELECT 4115276 UNION SELECT 37166577 UNION SELECT 42542211 UNION SELECT 42542234
    )
    GROUP BY co.person_id
),
class_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 'Platinum' AS treatment_class, 1344905 AS ingredient_concept_id UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Platinum', 1397599 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Taxane', 1378382 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Taxane', 1315942 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Antimetabolite', 1304919 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Antimetabolite', 1314924 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Topoisomerase inhibitor', 1350504 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Topoisomerase inhibitor', 1367268 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Topoisomerase inhibitor', 1378509 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Vinca alkaloid', 1343346 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Vinca alkaloid', 19008264 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Vinca alkaloid', 1308290 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Anthracycline', 1338512 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Alkylating agent', 1310317
),
class_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ci.treatment_class, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM class_ingredients ci
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ci.ingredient_concept_id
    UNION
    SELECT treatment_class, ingredient_concept_id FROM class_ingredients
),
class_index AS (
    SELECT lc.person_id, cd.treatment_class, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM lung_ca lc
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = lc.person_id
    JOIN class_drugs cd ON cd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= lc.lung_dx_date
    GROUP BY lc.person_id, cd.treatment_class
),
outcomes AS (
    SELECT 'Neurotoxicity' AS outcome, descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4024301
    UNION SELECT 'Neurotoxicity', 4024301
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Cardiotoxicity', descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 3655437
    UNION SELECT 'Cardiotoxicity', 3655437
),
patient_outcomes AS (
    SELECT ci.person_id, ci.treatment_class, o.outcome,
           MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_outcome_date
    FROM class_index ci
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = ci.person_id
    JOIN outcomes o ON o.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_start_date >= ci.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 366, ci.index_date)
    GROUP BY ci.person_id, ci.treatment_class, o.outcome
),
summary AS (
    SELECT ci.treatment_class,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ci.person_id) AS patients,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.outcome = 'Neurotoxicity' THEN ci.person_id END) AS neurotoxicity_n,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.outcome = 'Cardiotoxicity' THEN ci.person_id END) AS cardiotoxicity_n
    FROM class_index ci
    LEFT JOIN patient_outcomes po ON po.person_id = ci.person_id AND po.treatment_class = ci.treatment_class
    GROUP BY ci.treatment_class
)
SELECT treatment_class, patients,
       neurotoxicity_n,
       CAST(100.0 * neurotoxicity_n / NULLIF(patients,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS neurotoxicity_pct,
       cardiotoxicity_n,
       CAST(100.0 * cardiotoxicity_n / NULLIF(patients,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS cardiotoxicity_pct
FROM summary
ORDER BY patients DESC;

WITH outcome_concepts AS (
    SELECT 'Neurotoxicity' AS outcome, descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4024301
    UNION SELECT 'Neurotoxicity', 4024301
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Cardiotoxicity', descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 3655437
    UNION SELECT 'Cardiotoxicity', 3655437
)
SELECT oc.outcome, c.concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS condition_records, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS persons
FROM outcome_concepts oc
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = oc.concept_id
LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.condition_concept_id = oc.concept_id
GROUP BY oc.outcome, c.concept_id, c.concept_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY oc.outcome, persons DESC, condition_records DESC;

Methods: lung cancer was identified from OMOP condition concepts and descendants; chemotherapy classes were mapped from common lung-cancer chemotherapy ingredients and descendants in `drug_exposure`; outcomes were OMOP condition concepts for `Neurotoxicity` and `Cardiotoxicity` and descendants within 366 days after class-specific first exposure.

Caveat: these are crude EHR-coded event rates, not adjusted incidence estimates. Patients can appear in multiple treatment-class rows if exposed to multiple classes.
